description:
Designer & management software for xTool laser cutters & engravers.


General
1. Performance: Optimize the import and editing performance of complex vector files. Files open sooner, and dragging and editing feel smoother.
2. Support two modes for the AI Assistant — docked in the side panel, or as a standalone window. Switch between them at any time, and move the standalone window to a second display.

Editor
1. Support importing Adobe Illustrator (.ai) files directly.
2. Support adding rounded corners to any vector shape.
3. Add Resize Slots, which finds every slot and interlocking joint in a file and resizes them all to your target thickness in one step.
4. Add three sizing modes for text: Auto Width, Auto Height and Auto Fit.
5. Add the shortcut Command (Ctrl) + D for duplicating a selection in place. The command is also available in the menu bar.
6. Add the shortcut V in node editing to switch back to the Selection tool.
7. Add scenario presets to Nesting, along with a deep-optimization option that packs parts in tighter to improve material utilization.
8. In Print mode, new text and shapes are now filled by default.
9. Upgrade AI relief generation, with more depth and finer printed detail.

Material Settings
1. Add AI material recognition with setting recommendations: take a photo, and Studio identifies the material and applies matching settings.
2. Add test array recognition: Studio reads the results off your test grid automatically, so you can save and reuse them in one tap.
（Both features are supported on the following machines: M2, P3, P2S, P2, F2, F2 Ultra, F2 Ultra UV and F2 Ultra Single.）

Machines
1. Laser machines
- Add Offset fill, which follows the outline of a shape ring by ring instead of scanning back and forth across it, noticeably improving efficiency on hollowed vector fills.
- Add a Scan angle setting for choosing the fill direction of vector shapes. On materials with a visible grain, such as wood, lining the scan angle up with the grain gives a more even finish. (P, S and M series)
- Add Ramp, for sharper and longer-lasting engraved stamps. (P, S and M series)
2. O1 Omni Printer
- Add Roll Film Mode for batch-producing transfer stickers, wall art and more.
- Optimize device health information, with clearer ink level details and maintenance steps.
- Add default ink prices, so you can estimate what a print will cost.
- Support resuming a print after it has been interrupted.
- Support setting white ink reduction per element.
3. M2
Add Capture and Trace: the camera captures what is on the bed, recognizes the artwork and generates a cuttable outline.
4. F2 Ultra UV
Upgrade the internal engraving algorithm: visibly finer detail, and jobs now take about half the time on average.

Fixes
1. Fix an issue where nodes could not be deleted one after another. You can now hold Delete to remove adjacent nodes.
2. Fix various other known issues.
